description.value: A locally operated Subway franchise on Kingsway in Burnaby, offering customizable Footlong sandwiches, wraps, and salads built with fresh-baked bread, fresh-cut vegetables, and a range of proteins. The location features indoor seating and supports pickup, delivery, and curbside service. Situated on a busy commercial arterial in the Burnaby–Vancouver corridor, it offers a quick and accessible meal stop for cyclists passing through.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 30m; stands (5 spaces) at 95m. Total: 9 spaces.
